entries.rationale: R8 is mandatory: an Issue #453 checkpoint-shaped repair-target artifact must be processed once and advance through canonical recording to triage without invoking review AI. The touched test now asserts the generated helper artifact has verdict=ADVISORY, but that narrows the fixture away from the checkpoint shape documented in the issue and leaves the real production replay path unable to honor disposition-only evidence.
The added implementation flow state leaves the task test-execute step pending, so the diff does not show implemented code has passed project test execution required for readiness.
